87    // One clock for renderer timing, CPU scopes, RHI events and snapshot correlation.
88    std::uint64_t NowNs() noexcept;
89
90    inline double Milliseconds(std::uint64_t begin, std::uint64_t end) noexcept
91    {
92        return end >= begin ? static_cast<double>(end - begin) / 1000000.0 : 0.0;
93    }
94
95    class CpuTimer final
96    {
97    public:
98        CpuTimer() noexcept : begin(NowNs()) {}
99        double ElapsedMilliseconds() const noexcept { return Milliseconds(begin, NowNs()); }
100        std::uint64_t StartedAt() const noexcept { return begin; }
101        void Reset() noexcept { begin = NowNs(); }
102
103    private:
104        std::uint64_t begin;
105    };
